data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient machine-readable information was extractable from the provided scanned images to identify gross claims outstanding opening balance or a gross prior-year reserve movement. The report images supplied are low-contrast/rotated and key numeric notes (Balance Sheet technical provisions and Movement in prior years provision) could not be reliably read.
data.data_quality_notes: Images of the annual report pages are rotated and low contrast; OCR/text could not be parsed reliably. The Balance Sheet liabilities line 'Claims outstanding' and the note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' could not be unambiguously read from the scanned images. No clear gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure was found. Where only net or P&L 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines appeared, those were intentionally not used per instructions. All numeric fields are therefore null and confidence scores are 0.0 unless otherwise indicated. Recommend supplying a higher-resolution, properly-oriented PDF or the specific notes/pages (Balance Sheet liabilities and Movement in prior year's provision) for accurate extraction.
